nodes.title: About Flux Kontext Edit

widgets_values: Extract patterns from the clothes in the image and present them as clean, complete vector-style illustrations. The illustrations stand alone, are visually balanced, and have naturally processed edges. Remove wrinkles from the surface of the patterns.
